predictor.notes: Retained the saved predictor: additional in-memory challenges did not establish a better-supported replacement. It reproduces the observed exact totals at quantities 50 (50148 cents) and 200 (124248 cents), agrees with every successful estimate under 10000-cent rounding, and is nonnegative and increasing over integers 1..1000. A single global quadratic is inconsistent with the observations, but three alternative monotone piecewise models also fit every observation. Their predictions at quantity 300 range from 142832 to 164000 cents; these are competing predictions, not observations or guaranteed uncertainty bounds. The enlarged study allowance does not reset the exhausted tenant estimate quota, so no additional business requests were made. Cumulative usage remains 26 business requests and 5 REA operations. Segment starts are interpolation knots, not verified tariff transitions. Exact reconstruction remains unidentified: rounded samples constrain their true prices to approximately ±5000 cents, while no error bound is established at unobserved quantities.
